subject: EdgeWorks private deploy: IaC gating & egress sweep
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam Harper <liam.harper@edgeworks.io>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeWorks private deploy: IaC gating & egress sweep

Hi all,

EdgeWorks (cc: Liam) sent over their initial private-deploy IaC bundle this morning. They plan to run in a colocated data center behind a customer-managed FW with a small egress window. I did a quick skim and want to bring this to our IaC/security gating checklist before we proceed to any onboarding work.

Attachments: edgeworks-prereq-checklist.pdf, terraform-module-diff.patch, helm-values-sample.yaml

Top areas I want us to review and lock down before we sign off:
- Terraform modules: VPC/subnet mapping (tenant CIDR mapping), route table modifications, and NAT vs. proxy egress options.
- Helm charts: operator values that set outbound proxy envs, service annotations for internal-only LB, and any ACEs that expose ports.
- Ansible/bootstrapping: how credentials are injected for initial pulls; avoid baked-in creds or wide-scoped service accounts.
- CI gating: fail-fast checks for plan diffs that open 0.0.0.0/0 egress, or add route table changes without explicit approver.
- Audit/telemetry: ensure egress flow logs can be retained for 90+ days for compliance and we have a plan for sampling TLS inspection metadata where required.

Can each of you own a short pass and reply with: 1) 2–3 immediate blockers, 2) recommended quick remediations we can push into a patch, and 3) whether you need a meeting with EdgeWorks (propose windows below).

Proposed meeting slots (PST): Thu 2026-10-08 10:00, Thu 14:00.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Liam Harper <liam.harper@edgeworks.io>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeWorks private deploy: IaC gating & egress sweep

Naomi — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Quick preliminary notes from a Terraform/module perspective:

Immediate blockers (top 3):
1) Tenant CIDR mapping is ambiguous — modules assume /16 ranges but EdgeWorks is supplying /20s that will collide with our overlay. Need a mapping table and explicit param to pin tenant_cidr.
2) Egress configuration is binary in their modules (NAT gateway only). We should add an 'egress_mode' parameter with allowed values ["nat-gateway", "egress-proxy"] and validate selection in preflight.
3) The diff shows a route-change that would propagate a default route into a transit table (see terraform-module-diff.patch). Any route modification that touches 0.0.0.0/0 should fail CI unless flagged and approved.

Recommended quick remediations:
- Add a terraform validate/plan hook that searches the plan JSON for changes to route resources and flags any 0.0.0.0/0 or IGW attachments.
- Introduce a 'egress_audit' boolean module flag that, when true, enables VPC Flow Logs + S3/GCS retention and adds a lifecycle rule to set 90d retention for raw logs.
- Parameterize service account roles used by the bootstrap playbook; reject wildcard IAM binds in PR checks.

CI gating items I can take:
- Implement a premerge pipeline step (scripts/ci/preflight-checks.sh) that runs 'terraform plan -out=plan' + 'terraform show -json' and then a small jq filter to assert no default-route additions and that any changes to iam_* resources have an approver label.

Linking this to JIRA INFRA-9876 so we can track the gating work. I’ll draft a patch for the module (will push terraform-module-diff.patch -> a follow-up PR) and include tests.

Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer
From: Liam Harper <liam.harper@edgeworks.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeWorks private deploy: IaC gating & egress sweep

Thanks Naomi & team — quick context from EdgeWorks side: our deployment will sit in an air-gapped rack with a constrained outbound path through a TLS inspection proxy. Two constraints to call out:

- Outbound must originate from a static NAT IP range we control (we cannot use ephemeral NAT from the colo provider).
- TLS inspection will be run by the colo box; we can provide the cert chain but cannot expose private keys.

Specific asks from our security team:
- Helm chart overrides must include HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY env vars and a 'proxy.exclude' list for internal IP ranges.
- Ansible bootstrapping must not create long-lived tokens; prefer short-lived ephemeral tokens fetched at runtime and rotated by the operator.

We can attend the Thu 10:00 PST slot if that helps. I’ve attached the prereq checklist from our operations team.

—Liam
Liam Harper
Head of DevOps, EdgeWorks Inc.

Thanks everyone — solid feedback. Quick summary and owners so we can move this into a tracked set of PRs: 

Action items:
- Karthik: add 'egress_mode' + 'egress_audit' module params, implement the terraform plan JSON check, and open the module patch PR. (Owner: Karthik)
- Hannah: add the CI gating step and preflight script to devops/ci, include a blocker for any plan that adds 0.0.0.0/0 or IAM wildcards. (Owner: Hannah)
- Kimberly: prepare compliance evidence template for egress logs retention and the short-lived token pattern. Attach any AWS/GCP control mappings we can reuse. (Owner: Kimberly)
- EdgeWorks (Liam): provide the static NAT IP range and the proxy exclude list (please add to the shared Drive folder).

Meeting: Thu 2026-10-08 10:00 PT confirmed. I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda: 1) review module parameter changes, 2) CI gating acceptance criteria, 3) timeline for patch and rollout.

Thanks — Naomi
